title: Field boundaries for Austria (2025)
description: Agricultural field boundary polygons for Austria (reference year 2025) conforming to the fiboa 0.3.0+ specification, derived from official LPIS (Land Parcel Information System) data. Contains field polygon geometries with harmonized crop type codes (HCAT), native and English crop names, and area metrics for agricultural parcels.
